name: grafting
description: Grafting Monorepo -- workspace root. See GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md.

scripts.workspace:install: pnpm install && cargo fetch --locked && uv sync && dotnet restore System.sln
scripts.workspace:update: pnpm update -r && cargo update && uv lock --upgrade && dotnet restore System.sln --force-evaluate
scripts.workspace:build: nx run-many --target=build --all --exclude=grafting && cargo build --workspace && dotnet build System.sln --no-restore
scripts.graph:v1:check: node tools/scripts/validate-graph-ir.mjs docs/graph-ir/fixtures/valid-minimal.graph.json && cargo run -p grafting-graph-core --features graph-ir-cli --bin validate-graph-ir -- docs/graph-ir/fixtures/valid-minimal.graph.json
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run graph:map:check && pnpm run graph:manifest:check && pnpm run graph:extract:check && pnpm run graph:signatures:check && pnpm run docs:api:ts:check && pnpm run docs:api:rust:check && nx run graph-core:api-check && nx run ui:api-check && nx run render-3d:api-check
